qualifier: B-vitamin cofactor supply (cobalamin, biotin, thiamine, riboflavin, CoA, lipoate)
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA catabolism with B-vitamin cofactor supply
rationale: Members span mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation, branched-chain amino acid and organic acid catabolism, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, ketone bodies and the inborn errors of these routes, together with the B-vitamin cofactors they need, which separates the theme from one-carbon/folate, choline, threonine and peroxisomal long-chain neighbours.

name: Endothelial differentiation and vessel morphogenesis with Tie2 signaling
rationale: All members concern endothelial fate, arterial/venous/lymphatic specification, junctions and vessel maturation, and the Tie2, neuropilin and adherens-junction members distinguish it from the BMP-driven cardiac/pulmonary vascular and VEGFR-only neighbours.

name: Insulin-like growth factor response and bone maturation mineralization
rationale: Members combine IGF/peptide hormone responses with mineralization during bone maturation and chondrocyte development, and the IGF response distinguishes it from osteoblast, osteoclast and sphingolipid neighbours.

core: Type I interferon induction via IRF3
name: IRF3-driven type I interferon induction and cGAS-STING regulation
rationale: Members center on IRF3-mediated type I interferon production and its positive and negative regulation, with cGAMP import and cGAS-STING regulation distinguishing it from broader RLR/TLR antiviral and chemokine neighbours.

name: TNFR1 signaling to NF-kB and apoptosis
rationale: All three members are TNFR1 signaling and its regulation, distinguishing it from caspase-8/TRAIL death signaling and generic NF-kB regulation neighbours.

qualifier: telomerase RNA trafficking to Cajal bodies
name: Telomere maintenance and telomerase RNA Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members cover telomerase extension, C-strand synthesis, capping, ALT recombination suppression and telomeric chromatin, and the Cajal body/scaRNA localization members distinguish it from the general DNA repair and RNA processing neighbours.

name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan
rationale: Members share uptake and lysosomal clearance by scavenger receptors, efferocytosis and hyaluronan degradation, which separates the theme from the oxidized-LDL foam cell and microglial amyloid clearance neighbours.

core: Actin cytoskeleton remodeling in cell shape and repulsion
name: Rnd GTPase and semaphorin-plexin actin cytoskeleton remodeling
rationale: Members concern filopodia, cell polarity and growth-cone collapse, and the Rnd1-3 GTPase cycles and semaphorin-plexin repulsion distinguish it from dendrite arborization, cytokinesis and ephrin/Rac neighbours.

name: Mitochondrial valine catabolism and 2-hydroxyglutarate metabolite repair
rationale: Members are valine-pathway enzyme deficiencies (HIBCH, ECHS1) plus 2-hydroxyglutarate interconversion and toxic metabolite repair in mitochondria, distinguishing it from leucine catabolism and lipoylated dehydrogenase neighbours.

name: GABA and glutamate synthesis, reuptake and vesicular loading
rationale: Members cover GABA synthesis and degradation, glutamate/aspartate transporters and their disease variants, and synaptic vesicle filling and acidification, lacking the glycinergic and cholinergic transmission that defines the neighbours.

qualifier: DREAM/E2F control in stimulated CD4 T cells
name: DREAM/E2F cell-cycle transcription in stimulated CD4 T cells
rationale: Members share G1/S and E2F-target transcription under DREAM/p107/p130 repression plus cell-cycle modules of stimulated CD4 T cells, which distinguishes it from generic replication-initiation and G2/M neighbours.

name: Stress-induced senescence and restraint of p53-mediated apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate oxidative/stress-induced senescence, SASP and proliferative arrest together with negative regulation of p53-dependent intrinsic apoptosis, unlike neighbours centred on p53 transcriptional targets or oncogene-induced senescence chromatin.

name: Neural plate patterning and hindbrain segmentation
rationale: Members concern neural plate formation and border specification, dorsoventral axis and boundary formation, with anterior HOX, rhombomere and midbrain-hindbrain boundary members distinguishing it from somitogenesis, limb, forebrain and axial mesoderm neighbours.

name: Osteoclast formation by macrophage fusion and DAP12 signaling
rationale: Members cover osteoclast differentiation, proliferation, fusion and bone resorption, with macrophage fusion, syncytium formation and DAP12 distinguishing it from M-CSF and negative bone remodeling neighbours.

name: NK and T cell gene-expression signatures
rationale: All members are expression signatures of NK and T cells, unlike the neighbours that describe functional regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity.

qualifier: non-canonical caspase-4/5, AIM2 and NLRC4 against bacteria
name: Non-canonical and AIM2/NLRC4 inflammasome pyroptosis against bacteria
rationale: Members share pyroptosis via caspase-4/5, AIM2 and IPAF/NLRC4 inflammasomes and GBP-mediated bacterial defense, distinguishing it from NLRP3/NLRP1 and IL-1/IL-18 cytokine neighbours.

name: Cancer-associated TGF-beta receptor and SMAD mutant signaling
rationale: Seven of eight members are cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 (plus TCF7L2 mutants), distinguishing it from RUNX3, Hippo, mismatch repair and TGFBR3 neighbours.

qualifier: Fc receptors and BCR, mast cell degranulation
name: Fc receptor and BCR signaling, mast cell degranulation
rationale: Members cover FcepsilonRI and Fcgamma receptor and BCR signaling with mast cell activation, hypersensitivity and Fc-mediated phagocytosis, distinguishing it from B cell development, Th2/eosinophil and neutrophil neighbours.

name: STAT5-activating hematopoietic cytokine and FLT3 receptor signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2/3/5/7/9, EPO, TPO and FLT3 (including oncogenic fusions) signaling converging on STAT5 with CBL regulation, distinguishing it from IL-6/STAT3 and growth hormone/prolactin neighbours.

qualifier: adenylyl cyclase production and PKA-CREB activation
name: Adenylyl cyclase cAMP production and PKA-CREB activation
rationale: Members share GPCR-driven adenylyl cyclase activation, cAMP synthesis and PKA/CREB activation, distinguishing it from CaMK-CREB and phosphodiesterase cAMP-degradation neighbours.

name: Peroxisomal fatty acyl-CoA beta-oxidation
rationale: Members concern peroxisomal beta-oxidation of very-long-chain, branched and medium-chain acyl-CoAs (ALD, TYSND1, fission), distinguishing it from alpha-oxidation, fatty acid elongation/plasmalogen and NAD neighbours.

qualifier: GPCR agonists with Rho and Rap1-integrin signaling
name: Platelet GPCR activation with Rho and Rap1-integrin signaling
rationale: Members are thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and prostacyclin receptor signaling in platelets coupled to G12/13-Rho and Rap1-integrin cytoskeletal signaling, distinguishing it from collagen/VWF adhesion and degranulation neighbours.

name: Selenium metabolism and selenocysteine incorporation
rationale: Members cover conversion of ingested selenium compounds to selenide, methylation for excretion, selenocysteine synthesis and readthrough insertion, distinguishing it from sulfur, methionine and redox neighbours.

name: SLIT-ROBO repulsive axon guidance at midline and optic pathway
rationale: Members share SLIT-ROBO signaling in commissural midline and retinal ganglion cell/optic nerve guidance, distinguishing it from netrin, ephrin and other repulsive axon guidance neighbours.

qualifier: Gi/o-Gbeta-gamma signaling to GIRK and calcium channels
name: Presynaptic inhibition of transmitter release via Gi/o-Gbeta-gamma signaling
rationale: Members concern presynaptic depression of GABAergic and glutamatergic release through GIRK activation, Gbeta-gamma calcium channel inhibition and adenylyl cyclase-inhibiting receptors, distinguishing it from neighbours centred on release potentiation and inhibitory synapse assembly.
